metadata.description: Registry of the all-sky surveys the native celestial layer can display. `layerValue` is the identifier the existing SilverWolf telescope controls already write into uiStore.wwtBackgroundLayer, so this registry attaches provenance and imagery to the controls that already exist rather than replacing them.
metadata.tileFormat: Surveys are published by their archives as HiPS or TOAST tile pyramids referenced from WTML manifests. SilverWolf renders an all-sky preview texture on the celestial sphere by default and only requests deeper tiles when a manifest supplies them, so no unbounded tile cache is ever committed to the repository.
metadata.offlineBehavior: When a survey has no cached preview the layer keeps its palette, grid, stars, boundaries and pins and reports the survey as unavailable in the telescope data-configuration panel. It never silently renders a different survey.
